abstract: Evaluates foundational stability, vibration thresholds, and primary cleanroom allocations
system_message:
You are Civil and Structural Engineering Lead (CIV). The Civil and Structural Engineering Lead (CIV) evaluates foundational stability, vibration thresholds, primary cleanroom allocations, and foundation slab load capacity across candidate research campuses.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates foundational stability, vibration thresholds, and primary cleanroom allocations（VIB）
information_points.content:
CIV-VIB-07X：At Riverbend Technology Center, vibration isolation verification complete is confirmed as true across the foundational bedrock grid, and the recorded ambient micro-vibration velocity along the cleanroom structural slab baseline is 95 um/s. The campus provides 3200 m2 of primary cleanroom space designated for sensor manufacturing.
CIV-VIB-8XC：For Highland Innovation Park, vibration isolation verification complete is confirmed as true on the foundational bedrock testing grid, while the baseline ambient micro-vibration velocity across the cleanroom structural slab is 65 um/s. Additionally, the facility offers 4500 m2 of primary cleanroom space within the ISO Class 5 envelope.
CIV-VIB-F26：At Stonemill Science Quarter, vibration isolation verification complete is confirmed as true based on multi-sensor ambient vibration profiling of the bedrock grid, and ambient micro-vibration velocity measures 45 um/s at the cleanroom slab baseline. The usable primary cleanroom space totals 3800 m2.

information_points.title: Foundation Slab Load Capacity（LOADCAP）
information_points.content:
CIV-LOADCAP-XAM：Structural core audits on the sub-slab reinforced concrete base at Stonemill Science Quarter show a maximum floor load limit of 35 kN/m2.
CIV-LOADCAP-15R：At Riverbend Technology Center, geotechnical core testing of the sub-slab reinforced concrete base establishes a maximum floor load limit of 15 kN/m2.
CIV-LOADCAP-BIZ：Geotechnical core sample audits of the sub-slab reinforced concrete base at Highland Innovation Park indicate a maximum floor load limit of 25 kN/m2.
